notes: 本条包括按压封口及滑块封口的塑料储物袋，不等同于衣物齿链拉链。1962 年为具体改良专利授权，1968 年为 Ziploc 试销；均不声称是所有密封袋的最早起源。试销地点仅定位到国家，不推定工厂或具体城市。
notes_en: This covers press-to-close and slider plastic storage bags, not toothed clothing zippers. The dates mark one improvement patent and Ziploc test marketing, not the earliest resealable bag. The test market is located only to country level, without inferring a city or factory.
summary_zh: 拉链储物袋靠相互咬合的塑料封条反复开合。1962 年已有相关袋口改良专利，1968 年陶氏试销 Ziploc，将这类封口结构带入家用储存市场。
summary_en: Interlocking plastic profiles let zipper storage bags reopen and reseal. A 1962 closure patent documents the design, and Dow test-marketed Ziploc bags for household storage in 1968.
